For the human reviewer: CrazySim SITL Crazyflies in Gazebo at R2: with a radio URI in the yaml (commented template, crazyflies_mrs.yaml:3-9) the same server, topics and /all/emergency drive real Crazyflies. /all/emergency is swarm-wide: every enabled drone (cf_1 to cf_4 by default) is asked to cut its motors and falls if flying; the external vel_mux takes off on the first cmd_vel.
